warnings: Grid bubbles 1-12 and A, B, C are printed on every structural plan (S-01..S-06). The fourth row (the C2 column row along the walkway, 3.00 below C) carries no bubble on any structural plan; it is named D on the beam elevations B9/B10 of S-11 (bubbles A, C, D under the 6.00 + 3.00 chain) and on the ground-floor plan A-04 (bubbles A, B, C, D), so it is a named line here.

Architectural section A-10 (page 12) prints its bubbles as A and B with 6.00 between them; on the structural sheets the row 6.00 from A is C (B is the interior row at 4.10 that carries columns only at grids 3, 6 and 10). Grid geometry follows the structural sheets (op01 precedence 1); the A-10 chains are recorded against the structural ids.

x: two different edge lines are printed before grid 1: 1.10 (S-03, the ground-slab GS edge) and 1.00 (S-05, the roof edge) — they are two points, so two dummies 1' (-1.10) and 1'' (-1.00), primed in reading order. Same at the other end: 12' (36.00, S-05) and 12'' (36.10, S-03). S-06 dimensions the upper roof 1.00 beyond grids 3 and 10 -> 2' (5.00) and 10' (30.00).

y: A' (-1.20, roof eave on S-05/S-06/A-10) and A'' (-1.10, GS edge on S-03/A-10) are one before-origin sequence, continued after A by A''' (1.65) and A'''' (2.35), the B4 beam lines of the local chain 1.65 / 0.70 / 2.10 printed in bays 4-5 and 8-9 of S-03 and repeated on A-10.

The local chain 1.65 + 0.70 + 2.10 = 4.45 runs past row B (4.10). Read three times (S-03 bay 4-5, S-03 bay 8-9, A-10) and the slab detail S1 on S-10 prints the same 2.10 short span, so the third B4 line is placed at 4.45 (B'') and not snapped to B; scaled off S-03 the drawn beam also sits just below row B. Flagged on the line.

A''''' (3.00) is the ridge of the tall middle roof on S-06 (steel ridge + steel king posts ด้งเหล็ก on every B7/B11 tie beam). No tick is printed to it; it is the centre of the printed A-C 6.00 by the symmetry of section A-10 — scaled_from_grid, per-line flag.
B' (4.23) is the ridge line of the end-bay gable roofs (ด้ง คสล. / อกไก่ on S-05), printed '~1.77' above C on both sides — an approximate printed value, kept with a per-line flag.

z_levels are taken from sections A-09/A-10/A-11 (ระดับหลังคาน +4.52 and ระดับหลังอกไก่ +5.60 of the end-bay roofs are printed on A-09 — their ids carry the number because the same labels are used for +5.80 / +7.60; ระดับพื้นดินถม +0.00, ระดับพื้นชั้น 1 +0.50, ระดับพื้นชั้นลอย +3.10, ระดับหลังคาน +5.80, ระดับหลังอกไก่ +7.60 and the unlabelled +0.15 / +0.30 / +0.45 / +2.29), the slab details of S-10 (+0.00 / +0.15 / +0.30 / +0.45) and the beam-level tags of S-04..S-06 (+3.10, +4.52, +5.80). The footing depth is printed only as 'ตามผลการทดสอบดิน' (per soil test) on S-07..S-09 — no number, no level.

Dimension sweep covers the structural set S-01..S-11 (pages 24-34) the floor/roof plans A-04..A-06, the elevations A-07/A-08 and the three building sections A-09/A-10/A-11 (pages 6-13). NOT swept (op04 time limit before the scheduled shutdown): the architectural detail sheets A-12..A-21 (pages 14-23: toilet, stair, door/window, wall/railing, whiteboard, electrical, sanitary; the door/window sheets were read for the schedule files only) — they may carry further ticks (rule 4) that this master does not have yet.

Two close walkway-roof levels are printed: +2.29 (section A-10, 0.50 + 1.79) and ระดับหลังอะเส 2.35 (elevations A-07/A-08, 0.45 + 1.90) — 0.06 apart, kept as two levels rather than picking one (rule 4).
Scanned government set (สพฐ. 2562, อาคารเรียนอนุบาล ขนาด 3 ห้องเรียน); every value was read off zoomed crops of the page images.
